how: We read the website of every Dallas-Fort Worth wedding DJ listed on Lazo (63 listings, 45 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: corporate AV production companies, dance floor and rental companies, national DJ brands with a Dallas landing page, and a planner mis-listed as a DJ. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle the ceremony audio and the toasts outdoors in Texas wind and heat, not just the dance floor?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: Sound Sensations
picks.blurb: Eryk personally DJs every event rather than sending whoever is free that Saturday, after years working for two other DFW DJ services. Packages from $1,975, with a professional team keeping the night flowing from start to finish.

picks.name: SPIN DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Packing dance floors since 2012 with more than 1,000 events performed. SPIN covers music and sound for ceremony and reception, including a hands-free mic for the officiant and wireless handhelds for toasts.

picks.name: LeForce Entertainment
picks.blurb: Glenn Roush DJed from high school through college and founded LeForce in 2011. It has since grown into one of the largest DJ talent providers in Texas and the southern United States, by its own account.

picks.name: Dance and Joy Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Undaground brings 30 years of experience to weddings across Texas and Florida, including destination weddings in Destin and Miramar Beach. DJ and MC, photo booth options and lighting, with packages laid out on the site.

picks.name: DJ Riz Entertainment
picks.blurb: The largest South Asian wedding DJ team in America, by its own account, with over 20 years of experience across Gujarati, Telugu, Malayalam, Muslim, Ismaili and fusion weddings. DJ and MC for the Garba, Sangeet, Baraat and reception.

picks.name: Music Masti Magic - Indian Wedding DJs & MCs - Dallas & Fort Worth (Irving Location)
picks.blurb: Indian, South Asian and multicultural wedding DJ and MC services across Dallas-Fort Worth, from Punjabi baraats to fusion receptions. No generic packages; everything is customized to the event.

picks.name: DJ Big Al
picks.blurb: Booked since 2004, Big Al is an Arlington DJ by way of Louisiana with a laid-back mic style and a playlist from Frankie Beverly and Anita Baker to Drake, plus line dances old and new. DJ and MC packages and 360 photo booths.

picks.name: It's Your Night Entertainment
picks.blurb: Founded by a former KLTY radio professional and grown through personal connections, It's Your Night is a Dallas and Fort Worth wedding DJ service with wireless uplighting, live ceremony music and photo booth rental.

picks.name: Ambiance Entertainment
picks.blurb: Jaime Chavez is a bilingual wedding DJ and master of ceremonies who builds introductions and commentary around your relationships, surfacing memories from the past into the celebration. Dallas-based.

picks.name: Andy Austin Entertainment
picks.blurb: Born and raised in Dallas, Andy Austin DJed his first wedding reception at fifteen and has since trained in public speaking, improv, scriptwriting and master-of-ceremony skills to bring originality to receptions.

picks.name: Leonardo Event Group
picks.blurb: Since 2001, Leonardo Event Group has provided personalized DJ entertainment and lighting for weddings, with proms and corporate events on the side. The site leads with couples' own quotes, including 'never a dull moment'.

picks.name: DJ Tommy Scott
picks.blurb: Wedding DJ and MC services for Dallas, Plano, Frisco, McKinney and Rockwall, aimed at couples who want the day organized, guests engaged and the dance floor packed. Tommy works the ceremony through the reception.
